audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 said Urgot wins Level 1 while whys[0] on the same page says 'Level 1 is even'. The packet chart says Skill.
audit.why: At level 1 Nasus only last-hits with Siphoning Strike (Q, 255 range) and Urgot has one ability — nobody has a commit. Page and packet agree once the row is flipped.
audit.corrected: Row 0 = Skill, rating 5/10, proposed in both layers as a matched pair. Rows 1-6 stay Urgot, matching the packet exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Late spike blamed 'a fully stacked Nasus W Wither' and 'his auto-reset outscales you' without naming what actually beats Urgot late.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands (R, 120s at rank 1) grants bonus max Health along with Armor, Magic Resist and attack range. Fear Beyond Death executes below a health threshold, so more max health means the raw HP you must remove before the execute arms goes up while the storm is running.
audit.corrected: Late spike now states the R health bonus as the counter to your execute — the same fact the mirror recorded from Nasus's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid says to 'punish any walk-up with the corroded-armor amp' and calls Wither 'on a long cooldown early'. Neither is right.
audit.why: The armour reduction in this lane belongs to Nasus: Spirit Fire (E) reduces the Armor of enemies standing in it, on a flat 12s at every rank — standing in it makes YOUR armour worse against his autos, it is not a tool of yours. And Wither is 15s at rank 1 falling to 11s, which is a short window, not a long one.
audit.corrected: Do not stand on Spirit Fire; it cuts your armour. Wither is 15s at rank 1 — bait it and run the whole pattern inside those 15 seconds. Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset at 255 range, so the wind-up on his auto is the tell, not the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Wither 15s to 11s and Spirit Fire flat 12s are the two windows the lane is played in.
audit.corrected: Both written in with real values.

edits.before: From Q Corrosive Charge online you dominate: shove the wave into his tower so he loses stacks to your denial and plates, and punish any walk-up with the corroded-armor amp. His W Wither is his only tool and on a long cooldown early, so bait it before you all-in.
edits.after: From Corrosive Charge online you dominate: shove into his tower so he loses stacks to your denial and plates. Do not stand on Spirit Fire (E) — it shreds your armour, not his. Wither (W) is 15s at rank 1, not long, so bait it and commit inside those 15 seconds.

edits.before: This is the danger window: a fully stacked Nasus W Wither shuts off your ability to kite and his auto-reset outscales you, so close before he onlines.
edits.after: The danger window: Fury of the Sands (R) adds max health, so his execute threshold climbs out of your reach while Wither pins you. Close before he stacks.

edits.before: - Nasus Wither: matchup-defining — His only kite. Bait it before committing. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Wither (W), 15s at rank 1 to 11s: his only kite. Bait it, then commit. Spirit Fire (E) is a flat 12s armour cut.

edits.before: His only kite. Bait it before committing. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only kite, 15s at rank 1. Bait it, then you have 15 seconds to run the pattern.

edits.before: Reaching R Fury of the Sands + Wither online
edits.after: Fury of the Sands (R) health above your execute

notes: The mirror (nasus__urgot) flagged the same kit-generator issue I would have: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) carries a 'dash' flag, but Riot's text describes a lobbed explosive with no movement at all. I wrote nothing that depends on that flag. The worst error here was breakdown.mid crediting Urgot with 'the corroded-armor amp' — the armour reduction is Nasus's Spirit Fire and it works against you.
